effects_planner.about: The effects planner (calculators/plan_effects.py): the wind chosen against every view, the chimney plume traced on each view's frame, plume colour and mouth, contact shadows for props the behind painting removes, the window-change check and the fire's glow and flames. The smoke kinds and wind themselves are in the effects section. Added by the effects-camera-light helper (log 35).

wind_mix.unit: parts of the wind (across every view, away from the main camera, downward), normalised in use
wind_mix.source: film-kit works-effects.js WIND (-0.85, -0.12, -0.5), round 5 of log 34: across the views, a little away up the works, sinking a little

trace_step_seconds.source: scratchpad plugin-calculators/verify_test_cases.py (the trace that gave round 4's 0.044 and round 5's 0.188); a finer step moves the travel by under 0.005

visible_strength_min.source: Design (log 35): a puff counts as seen while its strength is 0.1 or more. Judged against round 5's eye: with this cut No. 2's plume is last seen at 0.432 across in W3, where the round 5 helper saw it fade ('fading out by about 0.45 across', works-effects.js WIND comment)

edge_strength_min.unit: puff strength (opacity, 0 to 1): a puff this strong counts at its edges (the card test) and over a figure
edge_strength_min.source: Skeptic (log 35): test puff top edges where the opacity is 0.2 or more; inventory (log 35) 'Keep figures out of live smoke': flag a figure crossed by puffs above 0.2 (round 1: a man in the brazier smoke read as a grey ghost). Untested by eye

travel_min_share_of_width.unit: share of the frame's width a plume travels while seen
travel_min_share_of_width.source: Judged between two recorded cases: round 4's 0.044 of the width was rejected (round4-result.json finding 4: the puffs piled up as rings and a hook) and round 5's 0.188 kept (smoke-final.json, works-effects.js); the design (log 35) put the line at 0.15. Nothing in between was looked at

other_chimney_clearance_share.unit: share of the frame's width a plume must fade short of another factory's chimney
other_chimney_clearance_share.source: Design (log 35); round 5 kept a plume fading 0.057 short of No. 1's chimney (works-effects.js: longer plumes ran on behind it and read as its smoke)

plume_lighter_than_sky_max_levels.unit: levels (0 to 255) the plume's brightness may exceed the sky's behind it
plume_lighter_than_sky_max_levels.source: Judged between two recorded cases, measured by plan_effects.py colour on the round 5 W3 plate: round 5's brownish smoke at +9 to +15 levels was kept, round 4's pale grey at +50 to +64 was seen as glow by the critic (round4-result.json finding 4). Nothing in between was looked at

mouth_seconds_default.unit: seconds a puff stays at the mouth's size
mouth_seconds_default.source: film-kit works-effects.js SMOKE: all three kinds use mouth seconds 2 (effects.smoke_kinds records it only for heavy)

figure_box_width_metres.unit: metres (a figure's width, for its box on the frame)
figure_box_width_metres.source: A rule of thumb: a man's shoulders are about 0.45 to 0.5 m across; used only to box figures for the smoke test

contact_shadow_size_per_footprint_diagon.unit: contact shadow side over the base footprint's diagonal
contact_shadow_size_per_footprint_diagon.source: Design (log 35): the notice corner's hand-set shadows (drum 1.0, chair 0.75, pail 0.55 m; notice-corner.js lines 129-135) come within 0.15 m of 1.2 x the base diagonal

glow_pulse_setting_max_share.unit: share of the glow's size its pulse may swing (amplitude over base, in the page's settings)
glow_pulse_setting_max_share.source: notice-corner.js fireGlow 1.25 + 0.02 sin (kept by the user, log 32; the filmed swing measured 1.2%); the earlier 1.25 + 0.1 sin (8%) slid the glow's rim 20 px on the road (filmed swing 2.8%)

flame_variety_min.unit: how far flame tongues must differ from each other in size (share, each way) and lean (degrees, each way)
flame_variety_min.source: Judged between two recorded cases: log 29 rejected flames like a neat row of identical cartoon teardrops (no variety); the kept pit-village-effects.js Flames vary size by 0.7 to 1.3 (+-30%) and lean by +-14 degrees. The minimum sits a little under the kept variety

window_change_after_word_seconds.unit: seconds after the word for the second still
window_change_after_word_seconds.source: Round 4 critic (round4-result.json finding 8): 'Check stills at 79.0 and 79.8 s' for 'busy' at about 79.2 s

window_mask.unit: levels (0 to 255): a lit window pixel is brighter than this and this much redder than blue

smoke_preroll_note.unit: seconds of pre-roll needed by smoke that depends only on time (ChimneySmoke, Smoke)
smoke_preroll_note.source: works-effects.js ChimneySmoke and effects.js Smoke place each puff from t alone (fixed seeds), so filming can start anywhere; a smoke started on a word takes its life (7 s) to reach full length

fire_smoke.unit: seconds, scale, wind (metres a life, times scale), metres above the coals, and whether it leans along the chimneys' wind (else along +x) for the brazier's live smoke
fire_smoke.source: film-kit works-effects.js lines 643 and 815 and notice-corner.js (effects.js Smoke: count 14, life 3.6; set with scale 0.75, wind 0.9, origin 0.16 + 0.35 m above the coals; it leans along +x). Round 6 (in progress) makes the Works' brazier smoke follow WIND (BrazierSmoke): set follows_wind true when that reaches the kit

camera_audit_built_set.about: The camera audit's built-set mode and page window (paper-film/tools/camera_audit.py --built-set, --timeline): no turn during a slide, the street's meeting point, slide magnification at the nearest painted surface, the frame staying inside the painted plate. The audit's own move limits are in the camera section (camera.audit_*). Added by the effects-camera-light helper (log 35).

plate_check_every_seconds.unit: seconds between camera samples checked against the plate

light_planner.about: The light planner (calculators/plan_lights.py): starting watts by inverse square, reach, cone, links, shadow casters, EEVEE shadow settings, the render-log check, lamps near the subject or the meeting point, lights brighter on a wall than on the subject, the dark-subject plan and exposure per view. Measured light values are in the light section. Added by the effects-camera-light helper (log 35).

reach_margin_metres.unit: metres past the farthest lit part of the target
reach_margin_metres.source: Design (log 35): the notice glow's custom distance 1.4 m = its lit part about 1.2 m away + 0.2 (assemble_notice_corner.py lines 156-178)

colours.source: assemble_notice_corner.py (notice glow, corner lamp); assemble_works.py lines 1195-1214 (the men's rim lights)

container_skip_within_metres.unit: metres: a fire's light skips every prop this close (the container it burns in, the chair beside it); other lights get a note for props this close
container_skip_within_metres.source: Judged to reproduce log 32's links: the notice corner's fire light skips the drum it burns in (0.41 m from the light) and the chair (0.30 m), but not the lantern (0.68 m) or the pail (0.83 m) (story log 32; lesson 120); the design (log 35) said 0.6 m

near_surface_within_metres.unit: metres: a camera-facing surface this close to a light is checked against the subject (a lamp lights the face it hangs on)
near_surface_within_metres.source: Judged between recorded cases: round 4's gate lamp hung 0.21 m in front of the pier's lane face and made it the brightest thing in W1 (round4-result.json finding 5); round 5's lamp is 0.6 m from the pier's inner face; the cottage window lights stand metres from any prop and no fault was seen from them

shadow_casting_kinds.unit: kinds of light that cast shadows (every other light casts none)
shadow_casting_kinds.source: Round 3 (round3-result.json works.summary 'Speed'): a Works plate took about 25 min with every light casting and about 6 min with only the fire, the lit doorways and the sky; state-picture masks fell from 42% to 5-9%

foot_patch_metres.unit: metres (width, depth) of the soft shadow under a figure that casts no shadow
foot_patch_metres.source: assemble_works.py lines 984-1047 (two see-through ovals under each man)

lamp_clear_of_subject_pixels.unit: pixels on the film frame between a lamp and the subject's outline box
lamp_clear_of_subject_pixels.source: assemble_notice_corner.py lines 93-101 (log 31: the far street lamp touched the board's post where the lines meet; lamps moved or removed)

near_ground_light_max.unit: W/m2 a light behind the camera may put on the ground at the frame's bottom edge
near_ground_light_max.source: Judged between two recorded states of the notice corner's street lamp behind the camera (worked out by plan_lights.py from street.blend's gas_lamp_0 and the composed camera): 260 W puts 0.050 W/m2 on the ground at the frame's bottom edge and 'flooded the near road' (log 31); turned down to 70 W (0.0135) it was kept

subject_light_over_key_max.unit: times the light the subject's own key gives it (all lights reaching it together)
subject_light_over_key_max.source: Judged between two recorded cases, worked out by plan_lights.py: the notice corner's notice gets 1.4 times its key in all and was kept with no burnt colour; checkout C1's bill gets about 62 times (mostly an area light 0.6 m below it, counted face-on) and its check 10 found 23% of the bill burnt white (scratchpad redesign/round5-checkout/check10/report.md)

exposure_range.source: page-3.js LOOK_W1 1.6 (the darkest view; others 1.0); the inventory's clamp 1.0 to 1.8
